About_&_Key_Points:
About
Dhoot Transmission Limited is a global Tier-1 manufacturer of integrated electrical systems, specialising across eight product families: wiring and cable systems, interconnect components, mechanical control systems, electronics and sensors, EV systems, switches and interfaces, protection and insulation, and power solutions.
[1]
From a single facility to a global network of manufacturing and engineering operations, the company delivers integrated electrical systems across automotive, electric vehicles, industrial equipment, agriculture, marine, railways, medical devices, and consumer applications.
